room: Belfry furnished in parts/room-11.mjs: ringer's bench (dark_oak_stairs) on the west side, barrel with a standing lantern in the south-west corner, and a hanging lantern at x19 z12 y34 under the bell beam. The bell stays the focal piece (dressings), the ladder cell x21 z13 and the bell cell x20 z12 y34 stay clear.
make.sh produced a whole build.nbt; the Belfry line shows 4 placed, no REFUSED or off-palette writes. Light is 10 to 11 at every floor cell, 0 dark.
Walk verdict is still NEEDS WORK: 0 of 8 floor cells reachable, because the walker cannot climb ladders (the Clock room is the same), not because of the furniture.
left: Walk verdict: `mcd room --only Belfry` and `mcd walk` report UNREACHABLE for Belfry and Clock room. The shell's ladder (x21 z13, y4..31) is complete, but toolkit src/rooms.mjs only steps up one block or drops up to three and never climbs a ladder, so the tower interior cannot be reached by the walker. Fix belongs in the toolkit (a ladder-climb rule) or in a stair route in the plan, not in this part.
The hanging lantern at x19 z12 y34 is UNSUPPORTED until dressings builds the dark_oak_log beam at y35 x19..21 z12 (bellHang). `mcd check` flags it now; it should clear once dressings lands.

The rooms.mjs view was rendered from above while the shell and roof were still stubs, so the look is only partial. Re-render the Belfry after the dressings and roofs parts are merged to confirm the bench and lantern read against the bell.

waste.what: Chose the bench facing by trial: the toolkit doc says stairs facing is the side of the full-height back, and I had to rebuild after a wrong guess; the legend comment in the module reads as a seat direction, which was ambiguous.
waste.cost: 1 extra make.sh run and one Edit
waste.tool: `mcd states dark_oak_stairs` with a worked example of a seat facing, or a B.stairs helper that names the seat direction (seatFacing) instead of the back.

waste.what: Worked out the belfry interior cell by cell (which cells are the ladder, the bell, the beam and the arches) and checked the lantern's support by hand from the shell and dressings description.
waste.cost: about 4 coordinate checks by hand, plus one failed lantern position found only by mcd check
waste.tool: A per-room cell map from `mcd plan` that also marks the cells reserved by other parts (bell, beam, ladder, arches), so the lantern and bench positions can be chosen in one pass.

waste.what: Diagnosing why the walk said 'no way in' took several reads of rooms.mjs and of the ladder column, to find out the walker does not model ladders at all.
waste.tool: `mcd walk` should print the reason an entrance fails, e.g. 'ladder at x21 z13 is not climbable by this walker', instead of the generic 'no way in'.

waste.what: The room view tool renders only from above while the shell is still bare, so I could not judge the furniture against the bell or the arches.
waste.tool: `mcd rooms --from-inside` or a flag that also renders an inside view at the room's entry, to check the furniture against the walls.

Hang the bell from the dark_oak_log beam at y35 and keep x19 z12 y34 clear for the lantern, so the two read as one fitting.
